class.name: Connecticut Dental Health Partnership — HUSKY B dental (administered by BeneCare ASO)

note.text: HUSKY B (Connecticut CHIP) dental coverage. Administration model (verified): Connecticut DSS is the program sponsor; Gainwell Technologies (CMAP fiscal agent) adjudicates and pays claims and is named here as payor; the dental benefit is the Connecticut Dental Health Partnership (CTDHP), administered by the BeneCare ASO (network, Plan-Net directory, referral coordination, PA intake — not the claims payer). There is no dental MCO. For Interaction 1 the benefit is simply confirmed active for a covered evaluation referral; no CRD/prior-authorization fires at referral — CRD (and DTR/PAS via Gainwell if a planned procedure needs it) applies at the treatment visit. Fixed plan structure lives on InsurancePlan/insplan-ctdhp-huskyb.
